title: Alert Composer: cost-aware SLO templates and handoff packlet
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and prototype a new 'Alert Composer' flow that combines SLO-aware threshold suggestions, cost impact preview, and a one-click 'handoff packlet' (compact summary + postmortem link templates) for on-call responders. This ticket focuses on the UI patterns, prototype screens, microcopy, and review artifacts. The goal is to reduce time-to-triage and provide clearer cost/quality tradeoffs during alert creation.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype covers full composer flow: select signal, SLO tie-in, threshold suggestion, cost delta preview, handoff packlet checkbox and editable template
User can generate a handoff packlet that includes incident links, runbook excerpts, and 'create postmortem' quick link
PM and Eng have signed off on SLO threshold heuristics and UX patterns
Design tokens and components are documented with accessibility notes (contrast, keyboard, ARIA)
Handoff packlet export generates Markdown clipboard payload and a linkable artifact stub for postmortem
comments: 2026-02-22 — Aisha: Initial research and sketches uploaded to Figma. Collected perf and cost signals from Monitoring team.
2026-02-25 — Marco: Spike with Eng on feasible SLO tie-ins. Decided to use 3-day rolling error budget as default for suggestions.
2026-03-03 — PM Riley Gomez: Requested explicit 'cost delta' tooltip and example numbers for small vs large orgs.
2026-03-08 — Eng reviewer Leila Park: Raised concern about runtime exposure of fine-grained cost estimates; agreed on server-side simulated delta with 95% CI.
2026-03-11 — Aisha: Updated prototype with compact handoff packlet modal and initial microcopy. Pushed Figma link to attachments.
2026-03-12 — Design review: general approval; noted microcopy tweak and added 'opt-out' checkbox for postmortem auto-linking.
decision_log: Keep default SLO heuristic = 3-day rolling + signal percentile mapping (50/90/99 thresholds) — chosen to balance false positives vs missed regressions.
Handoff packlet will be generated client-side but reference a server-side incident stub URL (PR to create stubs is in attachments).
Cost delta will show a coarse estimate (low/med/high + dollar band) with link to detailed batch simulation in Console rather than exact live billing number.
